observation.command:
sleep 180; echo "=== API deployments ==="; grep -E "Deployment of web application archive.*finished|Error deploying" /opt/tomcat-api/logs/catalina.out | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | tail -4
echo "=== endpoints ==="
for u in "xplan-manager-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-validator-api/swagger-ui/index.html" "xplan-dokumente-api/swagger-ui/index.html"; do
  c=$(timeout 30 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://localhost:8080/$u"); echo "  $c  /$u"
done
